en: Black-and-white postcard-style photograph of a monumental Orthodox-style cathedral with a large central dome topped by a cross and two smaller domed towers flanking the main façade. The building sits on a raised platform with broad steps leading to three arched entrance doors. The architecture features rounded arches, columned drum under the main dome, and decorative stonework. In front there is a landscaped square with paths, low ropes as barriers, and a tall streetlamp with two hanging lanterns. Surrounding the cathedral are lower historic buildings. The number "97" is printed in white in the bottom-right corner. Very faint library/collection marking is visible across the image center.
